headline: Nasdaq-100 settles at a record after a broad AI-led advance; futures halted into the Globex reopen
body: The Nasdaq-100 closed at 30,482.35, up 2.83%, 75 points under its 30,557.33 session high, and the Nasdaq Composite set a record close at 27,122.09 (+2.26%). Participation was uniformly positive: SOX rose 4.29% to 12,433.17, all eight tracked megacaps and all seven tracked semiconductors finished higher on the latest session, with Meta up 11.3%, Arm roughly 17%, Intel about 12%, Qualcomm 9.3% and AMD near 10% as it briefly passed a $1 trillion market value. Cross-asset confirmation came from falling yields, with the 10-year at 4.963% (-0.035) and the 2-year at 4.76% on the 18 September H.15, and from WTI dropping 4.8% to about $95.49 after reporting that the US stepped back from strikes in Yemen and signalled openness to talks with Iran. VIX finished at 14.87, essentially unchanged on a 2.8% index day, so the advance carried no volatility confirmation. That combination - a one-way trend day holding near its extreme, but with volatility unexpanded and the geopolitical premium falling - is why Tail is scored well below the blocking threshold rather than at the levels reached intraday. The assessment hour itself falls inside the 21:00-22:00Z CME maintenance halt, so the current slot carries no live price path at all; NQ last printed 30,781 within a 29,904.00-30,862.75 range. Shared Finviz context was partial this cycle, with futures and calendar sections unavailable, so cross-asset futures alignment could not be read from it and breadth, megacap and semiconductor sections were used only as latest-session confirmation. The week ahead is thin on data and heavy on Fed communication, with flash PMIs on 23 September, jobless claims on 24 September and the Trump-Xi White House summit that day as the largest scheduled checkpoint.

lookbackSummary: Over the preceding 24 hours Tail rose from 5 in the quiet Sunday-night and Asian hours to a peak of 33 during the US afternoon, as a broad AI-led advance held the index near session extremes with aligned megacap and semiconductor participation. The published series moved green through 10:00Z, yellow from 11:00Z and orange from 14:00Z to 19:00Z, then stepped back to yellow at 23 once the 20:00Z cash settle removed the opening-auction continuation mechanism. Stress tracked the same arc from 31 to a 57 peak before easing to 48, and Confidence improved steadily from 72 to 90 as live evidence accumulated through the cash session.
outlookSummary: The forecast holds Tail in the low band through the overnight cycle, troughing at 13 around the Asian close, then lifting into the watch band for the Tuesday US session with a peak of 24 across the 13:00-14:00Z window that covers the cash open and the Richmond Fed, Williams and Jefferson cluster. Mapped policy state is projected to stay at EA_ON overnight and at WATCH through the US session, never reaching the blocking threshold on current evidence. The narrow danger window spans 13:30Z to 16:00Z on 22 September. Key invalidations that would lift Tail beyond this path are an opening-auction continuation with shallow or failed retracements, the index holding near fresh extremes, or a delayed second leg after front-end repricing around the 17:00Z 2-year auction and Barkin remarks.
